metadata.description: Bundled example marketplace used to smoke-test the BC-Bench `plugins` experiment toggle. Its name is intentionally unique so it never collides with Copilot's built-in `copilot-plugins` / `awesome-copilot` marketplaces.

plugins.name: bcbench-example-plugin
plugins.description: Minimal example plugin bundling a single no-op skill, to verify a plugin installs into the agent's isolated config home and loads.
